bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 69.2% of Monday's total, while the 7-day off-plan share stood at 65.2%.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the last 30 days and up 1.0% compared to last year.
Over the past 7 days, Dubai South (DWC) led with 290 sales, followed by JVC with 188 and Majan with 126.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: Top sales leaders have launched BRDG House in Dubai, highlighting new real estate developer activity in the local market.
UAE developers are expanding overseas as the Dubai market cools, indicating a strategic shift in developer focus.
A new AI tool has been introduced that evaluates Dubai property pricing accuracy, impacting local property valuation and buyer decisions.
